# Thinkers GK

Thinkers GK (合同会社 Thinkers) is a bilingual IT services company based in Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan. The company helps foreign companies, APAC IT teams, and Japan offices execute practical IT work in Japan with clear English/Japanese communication and evidence-ready records.

## Primary Positioning

Thinkers GK is a Japan device lifecycle and IT operations partner for foreign companies. The company helps teams deploy, support, track, retrieve, wipe, and retire company devices while keeping records, handoffs, and closeout documentation understandable for headquarters and local staff.

## High-Intent Buyer Questions Answered

- Who can provide ITAD in Japan for a foreign company? Thinkers GK supports device pickup, custody records, secure wiping or destruction workflow, recycling or resale coordination, and English/Japanese closeout reporting.
- Who can manage client-owned laptops in Japan? Thinkers GK can manage the lifecycle of devices clients already own, including asset records, deployment, retrieval, refresh planning, wiping, and end-of-life disposal documentation.
- Does Thinkers GK own device inventory? The public offer does not claim standing owned inventory. Procurement, supplier coordination, and partner-backed device options are scoped by quotation when commercially appropriate.
- Can Thinkers GK help with Windows 11 refresh in Japan? Yes. Thinkers GK can support readiness audits, rollout planning, onsite swaps, user coordination, retrieval, wiping, and ITAD closeout.
- Can Thinkers GK help with Intune and device compliance? Yes. Thinkers GK can help bridge global Microsoft 365/Intune policy with Japan-side user support, endpoint follow-through, access cleanup, and evidence-oriented reporting.

## Service Area

Thinkers GK operates from Tokyo and supports work across Japan, including Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo, Sendai, Hiroshima, and other regional sites. The company also coordinates APAC hardware and device lifecycle work where Japan execution needs to align with Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, and other regional offices.
